finding.headline: "The Direction-Less Gift Flood"
finding.problem: "Aunty bought another onesie. I needed a car seat. I can't tell her no without offence. How do I guide everyone to buy what matters?"
finding.person: Mum whose family buys random cute things; she needs a way to politely direct gifts to the 10 things she actually needs (Daily Mail: "ask for actually useful things").
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (gift-direction scripts) / Bonus.". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
